title: A document could be rejected without a reason
steps: POST /admin/students/{id}/documents/{doc}/verify with { status: 'rejected' } and no remarks
actual: 200, document rejected with an empty reason
fix: shared/verification.ts: reason is required when rejecting

title: Transfer certificate PDF: 'Date of issue' text overlapped
steps: Issue a TC and open the PDF
expected: Date of issue printed cleanly on the right
actual: Label and date printed on top of each other

title: Import accepted impossible dates like 30 February
steps: Import a row with Date of birth 2015-02-30
expected: Row marked to fix: not a real date

title: Import errors used code field names (first_name, mobile) instead of column names
steps: Import a row with a wrong father mobile
expected: Father mobile must be a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number
actual: mobile must be a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number
fix: student-import.service.ts: friendlyMessage with the Excel column headers

title: Change class silently dropped a roll number sent without a section
steps: PUT /admin/students/{id}/enrollment with roll_no 3 and section_id null
actual: 200 and the roll number was thrown away
fix: students.service.ts setEnrollment: keep roll_no so the placement rule runs

title: When the API was restarting, screens showed 'Request failed (502)'
steps: Stop or restart the API and open any page or try to sign in
expected: Cannot reach the API. Check that the backend is running.
fix: src/lib/api/errors.ts: 502, 503 and 504 are treated as the API being unreachable

title: Mobile number error wording differed between forms
steps: Submit a bad mobile on Users, Students, Parents, Schools and Staff forms
actual: 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile' on some forms, '... mobile number' on others
fix: All forms now say 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number'
